brand.name: Arduino
brand.disclaimer: Unofficial hackathon demo; no endorsement implied.

creator_pitch.voice: Warm, confident female maker; conversational American English; medium-fast pace.
creator_pitch.person: Fictional East Asian woman, late twenties, credible product educator in a bright maker workshop.
creator_pitch.objective: Creator-led launch pitch for curious first-time and returning makers.
creator_pitch.hook: Your next idea can start on one board.

proof_demo.voice: Clear, calm female technical narrator; Mandarin; measured proof-first delivery.
proof_demo.person: No on-screen person; the product and three verifiable hardware facts are the evidence.
proof_demo.objective: Demonstrate concrete product capabilities without unsupported performance claims.
proof_demo.hook: 一块板，三个可验证升级。

ranking_listicle.voice: Energetic, credible US-Spanish tech reviewer; quick listicle cadence.
ranking_listicle.person: Fictional Latino male maker, early thirties, expressive engineer-creator.
ranking_listicle.objective: Rank three reasons to consider the board for a next maker project.
ranking_listicle.hook: Tres razones. La número uno está en la placa.

two_person_podcast.voice: Two distinct voices: thoughtful Black British female engineer and curious British male product host.
two_person_podcast.person: Two fictional adult hosts in a maker-lab podcast studio; balanced peer discussion.
two_person_podcast.objective: Handle the objection that the product is only a minor refresh.
two_person_podcast.hook: Is this really a new UNO, or just Wi-Fi added to the old idea?
